title: I Will Be Free
description: A vulnerable exploration of love, loss, and the journey toward personal liberation. This collection serves as a roadmap for finding light in the aftermath of shadow.

title: Unspoken
description: Finding the voice that trauma tried to silence. A collection focused on the power of naming one's truth and reclaiming the narrative of one's life.

title: The Overland Project
description: A forthcoming collection documenting the sensory and emotional restoration of the historic Lenox building through verse and industrial photography.
